Order management logical data model

A worked example of an L2 logical model page: subject areas, Mermaid ER diagrams and an entity catalogue. Used by the tests and as a template for your own models.

Reading the diagrams

An entity with no attribute list inside a section is defined in another section.

CORE

Core spine

How the subject areas connect. Attributes are in the sections that follow.

erDiagram
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ACCOUNT : "holds"
  ACCOUNT ||--o{ SALES_ORDER : "places"
  SALES_ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_LINE : "contains"
  PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_LINE : "is ordered on"
  SALES_ORDER ||--o{ INVOICE : "is billed by"
  INVOICE }o--o{ PAYMENT : "is settled by"
  SALES_ORDER ||--o{ SHIPMENT : "is fulfilled by"
CUS

Customers and accounts

Who buys, where they live, and the accounts they buy through.

erDiagram
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ CUSTOMER_ADDRESS : "has"
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ACCOUNT_CONTACT : "acts for"
  ACCOUNT ||--|{ ACCOUNT_CONTACT : "is managed by"
  CUSTOMER ||--o{ ACCOUNT : "holds"
  CUSTOMER {
    id customer_id PK
    string customer_number "shown on letters"
    string full_name
    date date_of_birth
    string email
    enum segment "consumer, small business or enterprise"
    bool marketing_opt_in
  }
  CUSTOMER_ADDRESS {
    id address_id PK
    id customer_id FK
    enum address_type "billing, delivery"
    text address
    string postcode
    date valid_from
    date valid_to
  }
  ACCOUNT {
    id account_id PK
    id holder_customer_id FK "account holder"
    string account_number
    enum status "open, on hold, closed"
    money credit_limit
    date opened_date
  }
  ACCOUNT_CONTACT {
    id account_id PK, FK
    id customer_id PK, FK
    enum role "owner, buyer or approver"
  }
EntityWhat it recordsRules it carriesRef
CUSTOMERAny person or organisation that buys from us.One customer can hold several accounts and act for others.CUS-01
CUSTOMER_ADDRESSBilling and delivery address history.Only one current address of each type.CUS-02
ACCOUNTA trading account with a credit limit.An account on hold cannot place new orders.CUS-03
ACCOUNT_CONTACTThe people allowed to act on an account.Every account has exactly one owner.CUS-04
ORD

Orders and products

What is ordered, by which account, and the catalogue it is ordered from.

erDiagram
  ACCOUNT ||--o{ SALES_ORDER : "places"
  SALES_ORDER ||--|{ ORDER_LINE : "contains"
  PRODUCT ||--o{ ORDER_LINE : "is ordered on"
  SALES_ORDER |o--o{ SALES_ORDER : "replaces"
  SALES_ORDER {
    id order_id PK
    id account_id FK
    id replaced_order_id FK
    string order_number
    enum channel "web, phone or store"
    enum status "draft, placed, fulfilled, cancelled"
    datetime placed_at
    money order_total
  }
  ORDER_LINE {
    id order_line_id PK
    id order_id FK
    id product_id FK
    int quantity
    money unit_price
    money line_total
  }
  PRODUCT {
    id product_id PK
    string sku
    string name
    enum category "hardware, software or service"
    money list_price
    bool discontinued
  }
EntityWhat it recordsRules it carriesRef
SALES_ORDEROne order placed by an account through one channel.An order can replace an earlier cancelled order.ORD-01–ORD-02
ORDER_LINEOne product and quantity on an order.The line total is the quantity times the unit price.ORD-03
PRODUCTAn item in the catalogue.Discontinued products cannot be ordered.ORD-04
BIL

Billing and payments

Invoices raised for orders and the payments that settle them.

erDiagram
  SALES_ORDER ||--o{ INVOICE : "is billed by"
  INVOICE ||--o{ PAYMENT_ALLOCATION : "is settled by"
  PAYMENT ||--|{ PAYMENT_ALLOCATION : "is split into"
  INVOICE {
    id invoice_id PK
    id order_id FK
    string invoice_number
    date issued_on
    date due_on
    money amount_due
    enum status "issued, part paid, paid or written off"
  }
  PAYMENT {
    id payment_id PK
    string reference
    money amount
    date paid_on
    enum method "card, bank transfer or direct debit"
  }
  PAYMENT_ALLOCATION {
    id payment_id PK, FK
    id invoice_id PK, FK
    money allocated_amount
  }
EntityWhat it recordsRules it carriesRef
INVOICEA bill for all or part of an order.The amount due never exceeds the order total.BIL-01
PAYMENTMoney received from a customer.A payment can settle several invoices.BIL-02
PAYMENT_ALLOCATIONHow much of a payment went to each invoice.Allocations add up to the payment amount.BIL-03
FUL

Fulfilment

Shipments that deliver orders, and the warehouses they leave from.

erDiagram
  SALES_ORDER ||--o{ SHIPMENT : "is fulfilled by"
  WAREHOUSE ||--o{ SHIPMENT : "dispatches"
  SHIPMENT ||--|{ SHIPMENT_LINE : "carries"
  ORDER_LINE ||--o{ SHIPMENT_LINE : "is shipped as"
  SHIPMENT {
    id shipment_id PK
    id order_id FK
    id warehouse_id FK
    string tracking_number
    enum carrier "post, courier or collection"
    datetime dispatched_at
    datetime delivered_at
  }
  SHIPMENT_LINE {
    id shipment_line_id PK
    id shipment_id FK
    id order_line_id FK
    int quantity
  }
  WAREHOUSE {
    id warehouse_id PK
    string name
    string postcode
  }
EntityWhat it recordsRules it carriesRef
SHIPMENTOne delivery of some or all of an order.An order can ship in several parts.FUL-01
SHIPMENT_LINEHow many of an order line went in a shipment.Shipped quantities never exceed the ordered quantity.FUL-02
WAREHOUSEA site that dispatches orders.FUL-03
